metadata.description: Environment name used to derive resource names. Supplied by azd.

Azure region. Restricted to regions where AKS, Foundry model deployments, Cosmos DB, and Speech are all available together. The original build of this platform constrained this to Australian regions only, for a customer data-residency requirement — if you need that, narrow the @allowed list back down to the region(s) you require.
Object ID of the operator granted data-plane access for break-glass administration. Recorded in the audit trail when used.
Capacity profile. Affects sizing only; every security control is identical in both.
Recover a soft-deleted Key Vault of the derived name instead of creating a new one. See modules/keyvault.bicep.
Kubernetes version for the AKS cluster.
Override for the Foundry account naming token. Leave empty to use the standard resourceToken.
Deterministic suffix derived from subscription, environment, and location.
Log retention in days. 365 to match the FR-052a audit and report retention period.
Principal ID of the control-plane workload identity, granted ingestion access.
Principal ID of the orchestrator workload identity, granted ingestion access.

properties.description: Fires when deployment failures exceed the tolerated rate (FR-054).

allOf.query: AppTraces | where Properties.event == "deployment_failed" | summarize Failures = count()

properties.description: Fires when queued deployments accumulate, indicating the per-tenant cap or worker capacity needs attention (FR-045a, FR-054).

allOf.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "groundwork_queue_depth" | summarize Depth = max(Max)

properties.description: Fires when any single blueprint stage attempt runs longer than expected (FR-054).

allOf.query: AppMetrics | where Name == "groundwork_stage_duration_seconds" | summarize LongestSeconds = max(Max)

properties.description: Fires when outbound dependency calls (Azure APIs, Retail Prices, Azure DevOps) fail at a sustained rate (FR-054).

allOf.query: AppDependencies | summarize FailurePerMille = 1000 * countif(Success == false) / count()

properties.description: Availability of authentication, plan generation, approval, and status queries. Excludes in-flight deployment progression per SC-014.

allOf.query: AppRequests | where Url !contains "/deployments/" or Name startswith "GET" | summarize SuccessPerMille = 1000 * countif(Success == true) / count()

properties.description: Fires when the orchestrator queue-consumption loop stops emitting its per-cycle heartbeat (FR-054). Silence means hung or dead worker.

allOf.query: AppTraces | where Properties.event == "queue_poll_cycle" | summarize Cycles = count()

properties.description: Fires when drift-watch classifies an onboarded tenant subscription as drifted - a readiness check regressed into blocking after deployment (FR-054).

allOf.query: AppTraces | where Properties.event == "platform_drift_detected" | summarize Hits = count()

properties.description: Fires when no drift evaluation cycle completes for an hour - the loop is hung or dead on every pod.

allOf.query: AppTraces | where Properties.event == "drift_evaluation_cycle_completed" | summarize Cycles = count()
